definitions.explanation: A mistake or transgression, often with moral or serious implications. Carries a heavier, more literary tone than simply 間違い and implies personal responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧な。
{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悔|く}やんでいる→悔やむ：14725_kuyamu⟧。
examples.english: I regret the mistakes I made when I was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訴|うった}えている→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: Many people are calling for the mistake of war to never be repeated.

notes:
USAGE:
{過|あやま}ち has a more serious and literary tone than ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ (mistake). It implies moral weight — a failing, a transgression, or a grave error — rather than a simple factual mistake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧ (to commit a mistake/transgression)
- {過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to repeat a mistake)
- {過|あやま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to acknowledge one's fault)
- {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過|あやま}ち (mistakes of youth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ is neutral and covers any kind of mistake. {過|あやま}ち implies moral responsibility and is often used in reflective, regretful, or admonitory contexts.
